title: Member safety
blockHelp: Blocking stops direct interactions and removes follows between you. Public posts can still be viewed while signed out.
muteHelp: Muted accounts are hidden from Latest, Following, and For You. They can still interact with you.
appealHelp: You can appeal an active hide of your post or comment within 14 days. An independent reviewer will decide.
appealReason: Why should this decision be reconsidered?
explanation: Decision explanation shared with the member
conflict: Another reviewer must handle this appeal.
selfError: This action is unavailable for your own account.
conflictError: An independent reviewer must decide this appeal.
ineligibleError: This moderation decision cannot be appealed.
existsError: An appeal for this decision already exists.
safetyCap: This safety list has reached its limit.
